roadmap.title: First playthrough: story and early unlocks
roadmap.description: Start a fresh game to earn the remaster’s achievements as you play. Use any difficulty for this run. Collect Power Cells during story visits, scan new machine types, and buy collectible maps from merchants.

roadmap.title: Finish the base game and clear the map
roadmap.description: Recruit the optional allies before resting in The Looming Shadow, then complete the ending. Finish the remaining base-game collectibles and activities in free roam; the ending returns you to the world before the final battle.

roadmap.title: Complete The Frozen Wilds
roadmap.description: Enter the Cut northeast of the Grave-Hoard. Finish its quests, collectible sets, skills, and combat targets on your first save. Upgrade Varga’s weapons before making the New Game+ loadout.

roadmap.title: New Game+ on Ultra Hard
roadmap.description: Create a New Game+ loadout from your prepared save and choose Ultra Hard. Complete the main campaign to earn both New Game+ achievements.

achievements.description: Obtained all Horizon Zero Dawn™ Remastered achievements.
achievements.summary: Earn all 55 other base-game achievements.

steps.text: Finish the base-game story, side activities, combat goals, and collectible sets. Complete every other achievement in the base-game portion of the guide.

achievements.description: Performed a stealth kill on 10 machines.
achievements.summary: Kill 10 machines with stealth attacks.

steps.text: Learn @mechanic{Silent Strike}. Hide in tall grass near Watchers and use Silent Strike on 10 machines.

achievements.description: Killed 3 enemies using the Strike from Above skill.
achievements.summary: Kill three enemies with Strike from Above.

steps.text: Unlock @mechanic{Silent Strike}, then @mechanic{Strike from Above}. Stand on a ledge over a weak enemy and use the attack prompt; land three killing blows this way.

achievements.description: Detached 10 components from machines during combat.
achievements.summary: Detach 10 machine components during combat.

steps.text: Scan machines with the Focus to identify removable parts. Shoot those parts off; Tearblast Arrows from a Sharpshot Bow make this easier.

achievements.description: Killed 10 machines weak to Fire while burning, or weak to Freeze while frozen.
achievements.summary: Kill 10 machines while they are burning or frozen by an element they are weak to.

steps.text: Check elemental weaknesses with the Focus. Fill a vulnerable machine’s Fire or Freeze meter, then kill the machine before that status wears off.

achievements.description: Detached 5 heavy weapons from machines during combat.
achievements.summary: Shoot five heavy weapons off machines.

steps.text: Use Tearblast Arrows to remove a @enemy{Ravager}’s cannon or a @enemy{Thunderjaw}’s Disc Launchers. Detach five weapons in total.

achievements.description: Override seven different machine types.
achievements.summary: Override seven different machine types.

steps.text: Gain the override ability during @mechanic{The Womb of the Mountain}, then complete @loc{Cauldron SIGMA}.
Sneak up and hold Override on a Watcher, Strider, Charger, Broadhead, Lancehorn, Grazer, and Scrapper.

achievements.description: Killed 30 human enemies by landing headshots on them.
achievements.summary: Kill 30 human enemies with headshots.

steps.text: Aim for bandits’ and cultists’ heads. @mechanic{Concentration} slows aiming; roaming human patrols and the replayable final mission provide more targets after camps are cleared.

achievements.description: Obtain and equip the Shield-Weaver outfit.
achievements.summary: Obtain and equip the Shield-Weaver outfit.

guide.context: The final cell becomes accessible during The Mountain That Fell. Power Cells remain available after the story. A cell picked up since the last checkpoint can be lost if you die. Save at a campfire after leaving each site.

steps.text: During @mechanic{The Womb of the Mountain}, crouch through the side-room vent in All-Mother and take the Power Cell. If you leave without the cell, return during or after @mechanic{The Heart of the Nora}.
As adult Aloy, revisit the childhood @loc{Ruins} east of Mother’s Watch. Break the crystal barrier on the lowest level and take the cell.
At @loc{Maker’s End}, climb the yellow holds above Faro’s office to the very top of the tower for another cell.
In @loc{The Grave-Hoard}, take the cell immediately beyond the door opened by the ring puzzle.
During @mechanic{The Mountain That Fell}, check the hidden purple-lit side area at @loc{GAIA Prime}. Before the outdoor rappel, drop left onto the rocks and enter the side room for the last cell.
Find the @loc{Ancient Armory} bunker east of Mother’s Rise and enter it with the cells. Insert two cells and set the first locks, left to right: Up, Right, Down, Left, Up.
Insert the remaining cells and set the inner locks: Right, Left, Up, Right, Left. Release the armor, open its treasure box in Inventory, and equip the outfit.

steps.text: Complete @mechanic{A Moment’s Peace} from Vilgund in Meridian, @mechanic{A Daughter’s Vengeance} from Yan in Mother’s Rise, @mechanic{Sun and Shadow} from Lahavis in Brightmarket, @mechanic{Honor the Fallen} from Namman in Meridian, and @mechanic{Sunstone Rock} from Janeva at the prison.
Finish @mechanic{Hunting for the Lodge} and its follow-up, @mechanic{Hunter’s Blind}. Continue with @mechanic{Deadliest Game}, then @mechanic{Redmaw}.
Complete @mechanic{Traitor’s Bounty}, then @mechanic{Queen’s Gambit}, to help Uthid and Vanasha.
During @mechanic{The Looming Shadow}, rest in Olin’s apartment after those quests are complete. The gathering scene awards the achievement.

steps.text: Before creating the New Game+ loadout, finish your weapon upgrades and stock up on ammunition, healing supplies, and resources.
Start @mechanic{New Game+} and select @warn{Ultra Hard}. Complete the main campaign and defeat HADES; optional quests and the Frozen Wilds story can be skipped.

steps.text: Begin @mechanic{Waterlogged} at Greycatch Dam and help Gildun close both sluice gates. Kill and loot the Snapmaw to recover the missing emitter.
Before returning upstairs, open the ground-floor side door near the Snapmaw area. Use the Focus to trace the pipes and turn the valves until the water is routed through the drainage system.
Finish the remaining quest objectives and speak to Laulai at the overflow basin. If the quest is already finished, re-enter Greycatch and solve the optional ground-floor pipe puzzle.

achievements.summary: Kill all 10 machines in Ikrie’s Challenge.

steps.text: Complete @mechanic{The Survivor}, available at the camp southwest of Snowchants. Speak to @npc{Ikrie} at @loc{Snowchants Hunting Ground} to start her challenge.
Lure machines toward Ikrie so she can freeze them, then shoot their weak spots. Kill all 10 with the supplied arrows; crafting more ammunition is disabled.

achievements.description: Obtain Varga’s improved Forgefire, Stormslinger, and Icerail.
achievements.summary: Obtain Varga’s improved Forgefire, Stormslinger, and Icerail.

steps.text: Obtain the @item{Stormslinger} from The Shaman’s Path, the @item{Icerail} from For the Werak, and the @item{Forgefire} from Stone Yield’s bandit leader. Visit @npc{Varga} in @loc{Longnotch}.
Accept @mechanic{Geared Up: Forgefire}. Kill and loot a Bellowback for its Snout, then bring the part to Varga.
Accept @mechanic{Geared Up: Stormslinger}. Meet Varga at the marked Stormbird site, kill the machine, and return its Talon to her.
Accept @mechanic{Geared Up: Icerail} and travel to Varga’s marked Thunderjaw encounter. Kill the Thunderjaw, loot its Mandible, and deliver the part to Varga.

collectibles.location: Ikrie at Snowchants after The Survivor.
collectibles.method: Earn first place by killing all 10 challenge machines.

collectibles.name: The Claws Beneath
collectibles.location: Longnotch.
collectibles.method: Accept the errand and kill the marked Daemonic Rockbreaker.

collectibles.name: Out of the Forge
collectibles.location: Aratak after The Forge of Winter.
collectibles.method: Kill all five marked Fireclaws and finish the errand.

achievements.description: Completed the Tallneck, Bandit Camp and Hunting Ground in the Cut.
achievements.summary: Complete the Cut’s Tallneck and bandit camp and earn first place in every Snowchants trial.

steps.text: Repair the @loc{Frostfigures Tallneck} with its three marked components, then climb it and override the head. Clear @loc{Stone Yield} of bandits.

At @loc{Snowchants Hunting Ground}, earn first place in Control Trial within 0:55, Onslaught Trial within 3:30, and Chieftain’s Trial within 4:30. The Chieftain’s Trial opens after @mechanic{For the Werak}.
Use Varga’s improved Stormslinger for Control Trial. After the final first-place result, speak to the Grounds Master to claim the award.

achievements.description: Applied a modification to your spear.
achievements.summary: Insert a modification into Aloy’s spear.

steps.text: Speak to @npc{Kamut} north of Song’s Edge and finish @mechanic{A Secret Shared} by recovering the Drone Hangar part. In Crafting, fit a spear modification into the newly unlocked slot.

achievements.description: Killed 5 enemies using the Dismount Strike skill.
achievements.summary: Kill five enemies with Dismount Strike.

steps.text: Learn @mechanic{Dismount Strike} in the Traveler tree. Ride an overridden Strider, Broadhead, or Charger beside a weak enemy and use the Dismount Strike prompt. Get five kills with that attack.

achievements.description: Used the Machine Repair or Mount Repair skill on 5 different types of machine.
achievements.summary: Repair five different machine types with Machine Repair or Mount Repair.

steps.text: Unlock @mechanic{Machine Repair} and SIGMA overrides. Damage and override a Strider, Broadhead, Charger, Grazer, and Lancehorn.
Approach each damaged friendly machine and hold Repair, spending Metal Shards. Restore health to all five species.

achievements.description: Killed 15 Scorcher machines.
achievements.summary: Kill 15 Scorchers.

steps.text: After @mechanic{For the Werak}, replay the @mechanic{Chieftain’s Trial} at Snowchants. Kill its Scorchers and start another attempt until the total reaches 15; earlier quest kills also count.

achievements.description: Killed 10 Frostclaw machines.
achievements.summary: Kill 10 Frostclaws.

steps.text: After @mechanic{For the Werak}, replay the @mechanic{Chieftain’s Trial} at Snowchants. Kill its Frostclaws and start another attempt until the total reaches 10; earlier quest kills also count.

achievements.description: Killed 6 Fireclaw machines.
achievements.summary: Kill six Fireclaws.

steps.text: Kill the Fireclaw in @mechanic{The Forge of Winter}. Afterward, accept @mechanic{Out of the Forge} from Aratak and personally kill its five marked Fireclaws.

achievements.description: Disabled all Control Towers by overriding or destroying them.
achievements.summary: Disable every Control Tower in the Cut.

guide.context: Tower icons can remain hidden until you approach. Towers heal nearby machines, so disable the tower before fighting its guards.

collectibles.name: Shaman’s Path
collectibles.location: The tower Naltuk shows you.
collectibles.method: Sneak to the base and override the tower, or shoot its exposed cooling element.

collectibles.name: Shaman’s Path, second tower
collectibles.location: Later along the Shaman’s Path, near the campfire before the route ends.
collectibles.method: Override the base or destroy the tower’s cooling element.

collectibles.name: Northeast of Song’s Edge
collectibles.location: Shell-Walker site.
collectibles.method: Sneak to the base and override the tower, or shoot its exposed cooling element.

collectibles.name: Song’s Edge–Longnotch road, first tower
collectibles.location: Scorcher and Longleg area; one of the two towers.
collectibles.method: Sneak to the base and override the tower, or shoot its exposed cooling element.

collectibles.name: Song’s Edge–Longnotch road, second tower
collectibles.location: Scorcher and Longleg area; the other tower.
collectibles.method: Sneak to the base and override the tower, or shoot its exposed cooling element.

collectibles.name: South of Longnotch
collectibles.location: Stalker and Redeye Watcher site.
collectibles.method: Sneak to the base and override the tower, or shoot its exposed cooling element.

collectibles.name: South of Stone Yield
collectibles.location: Near the large volcanic pool and Fire Bellowbacks.
collectibles.method: Sneak to the base and override the tower, or shoot its exposed cooling element.

collectibles.name: West of the northern volcanic pool
collectibles.location: Inside the ruined lodge.
collectibles.method: Sneak to the base and override the tower, or shoot its exposed cooling element.

collectibles.name: The Claws Beneath
collectibles.location: Daemonic Rockbreaker valley in the northeast.
collectibles.method: Sneak to the base and override the tower, or shoot its exposed cooling element.

collectibles.name: Greycatch frozen lake, north tower
collectibles.location: The Hunters Three hunting area.
collectibles.method: Sneak to the base and override the tower, or shoot its exposed cooling element.

collectibles.name: Greycatch frozen lake, middle tower
collectibles.location: The Hunters Three hunting area.
collectibles.method: Sneak to the base and override the tower, or shoot its exposed cooling element.

collectibles.name: Greycatch frozen lake, south tower
collectibles.location: The Hunters Three hunting area.
collectibles.method: Sneak to the base and override the tower, or shoot its exposed cooling element.

achievements.description: Found all of the Pigments in the Cut.
achievements.summary: Collect all nine Pigments in the Cut.

collectibles.name: Light Salt
collectibles.location: Beside Kamut, at the dye pools on Song’s Edge’s northern outskirts.
collectibles.method: Search the tall mineral rock.

collectibles.name: Medium Salt
collectibles.location: Upper muddy pools inside Stone Yield.
collectibles.method: Clear the bandit camp, then search the tall mineral deposit.

collectibles.name: Dark Salt
collectibles.location: Hot springs east of Enjuk.
collectibles.method: Search the bronze-stained rock beside a large geyser.

collectibles.name: Light Crystal
collectibles.location: Ledge northeast of Frostfigures, above the lit cave and Lancehorn herd.
collectibles.method: Search the small black rock beside a tree.

collectibles.name: Medium Crystal
collectibles.location: Cliff path north of Stone Yield.
collectibles.method: Search the small black rock beside the high path.

collectibles.name: Dark Crystal
collectibles.location: Summit of Frostfigures, on Aratak’s side.
collectibles.method: Begin at the eastern climb; follow the route down and back up to the summit deposit.

collectibles.name: Light Oxide
collectibles.location: Shaman’s Path waterfall chamber, at Activate the Bridge.
collectibles.method: Lower the rope ladder and search beside the supply crate near the pool.

collectibles.name: Medium Oxide
collectibles.location: Icy lake southwest of Longnotch; check the northern shoreline.
collectibles.method: Search the copper-stained rock on the shore.

collectibles.name: Dark Oxide
collectibles.location: West of the frozen lake and Banuk camp west of Frostfigures.
collectibles.method: Search the copper-stained rock beside the mountain path.

achievements.description: Found all of the Animal Figurines in the Cut.
achievements.summary: Collect all six Animal Figurines in the Cut.

collectibles.name: Animal Figurine 1
collectibles.location: Lodge ruins north of Enjuk, on Greycatch’s northeastern side.
collectibles.method: Search the fireplace near the Control Tower.

collectibles.name: Animal Figurine 2
collectibles.location: Ruined building at the river below Greycatch Dam.
collectibles.method: Search the window by the river.

collectibles.name: Animal Figurine 3
collectibles.location: Northwest of Song’s Edge, inside a ruined house at the Charger herd.
collectibles.method: Search the window opening.

collectibles.name: Animal Figurine 4
collectibles.location: Final room in Ourea’s Retreat.
collectibles.method: During The Shaman’s Path, search the bench on the eastern wall. Return visits must follow the path from the southern campfire.

collectibles.name: Animal Figurine 5
collectibles.location: Drone Hangar at the northern edge of the Cut.
collectibles.method: During A Secret Shared, reach the suspended platforms in the first room using the ladder and drone.

collectibles.name: Animal Figurine 6
collectibles.location: Ruined arch northeast of Song’s Edge.
collectibles.method: Enter the opening on the northern side of the arch.

achievements.description: Traded Bluegleam for a special weapon or outfit.
achievements.summary: Buy a weapon or outfit using Bluegleam.

steps.text: Gather @item{Bluegleam} from quests or deposits in the Cut. At the blue-marked merchant in @loc{Song’s Edge}, spend 12 Bluegleam on the @item{Banuk Champion Bow}.

achievements.description: Learned all of the new skills in the Frozen Wilds.
achievements.summary: Learn all eight Traveler skills.

steps.text: Spend 18 skill points to fill the @mechanic{Traveler} tree. Points earned in the base game can also be spent here.

achievements.description: Reached player level 60.
achievements.summary: Raise Aloy to level 60.

steps.text: Earn experience through quests, Hunting Grounds, and other map activities until the next required level-up.
